reason: The keyboard router orders document-wide layers and reconciles focus isolation and CloseWatcher state after mutations; watchedAttributes is the declared layer input set.
The sole shared component discovery observer inspects added and removed subtrees, preserves connected moves, and never updates already mounted roots.
The iframe bridge discovers sandboxed message frames and remeasures frames revealed by an ancestor collapsible anywhere in the document. Frame readiness polling is bounded and setup is idempotent.
The iframe bridge projects only root class changes into message documents; this does not discover or reconcile unrelated UI components.
Declared control triggers project disabled state into their hidden form values. Only disabled attribute changes are observed, with guarded property writes; there is no child-list discovery.
An active tour waits for step text at its anchor, falling back to the body when no anchor exists. closeStep disconnects this observer.
An active tour follows anchors replaced anywhere in the document. The subscription exists only during an open step and disconnects in closeStep.
The persistent shell projects chat status, selected-thread changes, and chat replacement into its rail badge. Paint methods guard unchanged outputs; batching is only a scheduling optimization.
The legacy agent preview mirrors root theme class changes into its iframe. This class-only bridge is retained outside the priority component migration; it must not gain discovery or broader inputs.

Pill utilities can be added to any existing element by class mutations, so their discovery has no stable component root. This service marks only added subtrees and individual class-change targets; it does not rediscover or reconcile unrelated components.
